title: Fields in practitioner_accounts.csv
description: Documentation for the structured snapshot of public first-person AI-assisted Lean accounts.

columns.id: Stable local identifier; unique and nonempty.
columns.date: Publication date when known; may be a year or year-month when the source does not expose a full date.
columns.author: Named author(s) of the public account.
columns.title: Title or concise public description of the source.
columns.source_type: blog, paper, repository_transcript, social_post, forum_post, essay, zulip, or human_study.
columns.target: Mathematical or formal target described by the source.
columns.reported_lean_experience: none, novice, learning, some, expert, mixed, or not_reported; recorded only when supported by the source.
columns.reads_generated_lean: none, selective, substantial, varied, or not_reported.
columns.separate_ai_review: yes/no/unclear: whether a distinct AI review role is explicitly described.
columns.semantic_mismatch: yes/no/qualified/unclear: explicit statement, definition, scope, or correspondence mismatch.
columns.source_defect_found: yes/no/unclear: formalization exposed a defect in the informal mathematical source.
columns.counterexample_used: yes/no/unclear: a counterexample was used to diagnose or communicate a problem.
columns.persistent_project_state: yes/no/unclear: TODOs, plans, Git records, correspondence documents, or comparable state outside chat.
columns.posthoc_understanding: yes/no/unclear: the account explicitly describes human mathematical understanding after formal verification.
columns.human_role: Source-grounded short description of the reported human activity.
columns.observation: Concise paraphrase of the observation used by the paper.
columns.source_note: Qualification or provenance note, especially where a categorical field could be misread.
